text:
olivia: Quick sync request — vendor roadmap update needed for H100/H200/B200, MI300 and Gaudi. We have a marketplace announce window tentatively in late Q3 and vendors want SI test windows before handoff. Can we align on: availability dates, embargo/press lock windows, SI integration test dates, and fallback variants?

mike: +1. Do we have firm EOL/GA dates from vendors? H200ETA was shaky last time.

ravi: putting the latest tracker here: https://bit.ly/rwd-gpu-roadmap-v2 (spreadsheet with columns: vendor, sku, ga_date, embargo_start, embargo_end, si_test_start, si_test_end)

amy: tagging @jenn from marketplace — we need the marketplace cutover freeze policy so we can map embargo windows. Jenn, any constraints? :eyes:

partners-bot: Calendar invite created: "Vendor Roadmap + SI Test Window Alignment" Wed 10:00am PT — attendees: partnerships, marketplace, integration.ics

jenn: marketplace freeze: two-week embargo buffer required before publish; final SKU list must be in 10 business days before that buffer. Also need commit on firmware/driver image tags.

tom: FYI infra note — capacity for MI300 in our dedicated pools is constrained late-Aug; if vendors slide we may need to route some early traffic to quantized B200 instances or host small batches in partner clouds.

sierra: vendors asked for embargo lock from 2026-09-15 to 2026-09-22 (example). They want SI test window the two weeks prior. Can we target SI test: 2026-09-01 -> 2026-09-14?

mike: That SI window OK for partners? Also need to confirm SI image publish cadence: do we require a frozen container a week before SI tests start?

ravi: from vendor A: GA = 2026-09-08, embargo_range = 2026-09-15..2026-09-22; vendor B is more fluid (TBD). I added a `notes` column for contingency (fallback to H100 compatible kernel).

amy: Proposed minimal action items: 1) get firm GA/embargo dates from all 3 vendors by EOD Fri; 2) marketplace to commit to freeze policy and publishable SKU list by next Tue; 3) infra to provision MI300 capacity reservation for 2026-08-25..2026-09-20; 4) SI to schedule integration runbooks and test harness by 2026-08-20.

partners-bot: Reminder set for: vendor confirmations (72h), marketplace SKU list (7d), infra reservation (14d).

olivia: Perfect. I'll own the vendor confirmations thread and loop in legal on embargo wording. Can everyone add one sentence in the tracker under your org's column with risk and fallback? Example: "infra: can fall back to quantized B200; needs 48h to flip routing."

sierra: added: "si: can run smoke on H100 fallback images; full perf/scale tests require MI300 capacity."

mike: noted: "partnerships: ensure PSA to press for staggered announce windows if GA slips; prefer soft announce for SI partners only initially."

olivia: Thanks — follow-ups: I'll send a short agenda and attach the tracker to the invite. If anyone sees a hard blocker (firm GA later than 2026-09-08) flag it here asap. :thumbsup:
